title: Create src/templates/website/ directory structure
description: Create the skeleton directory structure for the website (PHP + MySQL) project template. This is the container for the PHP website template files.

steps.description: Create the website template directory tree
steps.details: Create all four subdirectories: src/templates/website/public/, src/templates/website/src/, src/templates/website/templates/, src/templates/website/config/
Add empty .gitkeep files to any directories that don't yet contain files to ensure they are tracked by git.
Run `find src/templates/website -type d` and confirm all four subdirectories exist.

technicalNotes: The PHP template follows a simple MVC-like structure: public/ for web root, src/ for PHP classes/controllers, templates/ for PHP view files, config/ for configuration
